_about: Background hero video loops: which page shows which loop. scripts/hero-video.mjs renders the partials (site-src/partials/hero-video-<clip>.html, plus hero-video-<clip>-poster.html for clips with poster: true, used by the plain navy service heroes that have no photo of their own), places the marker in each matched page's hero and the hero-video.css link (and poster preloads) in that page's <head>; scripts/apply-partials.js stamps the markup. Edit this file, then run: node scripts/hero-video.mjs. The first rule whose regex matches a page (path relative to docs/, forward slashes) wins; a page no rule matches gets no video. Footage is Joe's own drone video of his own jobs (ORC clips: his crew, confirmed 2026-10-16), re-encoded muted with every metadata atom stripped (tests/hero-video.test.js scans the bytes). Pages whose hero photo is captioned as one specific job (svc-hero--photo, 'see this job') are deliberately NOT mapped: a loop from a different job would make that caption untrue.
